title: Reading Comprehension — Level 3 — Tap all the true statements

items.prompt: Komodo report: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: The Komodo dragon is the largest lizard in the world. It can grow up to three metres long. It lives on a few islands in East Nusa Tenggara and eats deer, pigs, and buffalo.

visual.text: It is a kind of lizard.

choices.say: It is a kind of lizard.

visual.text: It can be about three metres long.

choices.say: It can be about three metres long.

items.reteach: Cocokkan setiap pernyataan dengan teks: kadal terbesar, hingga 3 meter, makan rusa, babi, kerbau.

items.prompt: Mount Bromo text: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Mount Bromo is an active volcano in East Java. Visitors often come before dawn to watch the sunrise. Around the crater lies a wide "sea of sand".

visual.text: Many visitors come early in the morning.

choices.say: Many visitors come early in the morning.

visual.text: There is sand around the crater.

choices.say: There is sand around the crater.

visual.text: Visitors come only to watch the sunset.

choices.say: Visitors come only to watch the sunset.

visual.text: The crater is full of sea water.

choices.say: The crater is full of sea water.

items.reteach: Teks menyebut gunung aktif, pengunjung datang sebelum fajar, dan ada lautan pasir.

items.prompt: Description of Laila: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: My cousin Laila is tall and has curly hair. She is a calm person who rarely gets angry. Every afternoon she trains at a badminton club near her house.

items.reteach: "Calm person who rarely gets angry" berarti sabar; ia berlatih setiap sore.

items.prompt: Bat report: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly. Most bats are active at night. Some eat insects, while others eat fruit and help spread seeds in forests.

visual.text: Many bats are active at night.

choices.say: Many bats are active at night.

visual.text: Bats are a kind of bird.

choices.say: Bats are a kind of bird.

items.reteach: Hanya sebagian kelelawar makan buah dan menyebarkan biji; kelelawar adalah mamalia.

items.prompt: Taman Bungkul text: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Taman Bungkul is a public park in the centre of Surabaya. It has a jogging track, a skate area, and free Wi-Fi. On Sunday mornings it is crowded with families.

visual.text: Families visit it on Sunday mornings.

choices.say: Families visit it on Sunday mornings.

visual.text: It is quiet on Sunday mornings.

choices.say: It is quiet on Sunday mornings.

items.reteach: Teks: di pusat Surabaya, ada jogging track dan Wi-Fi gratis, ramai keluarga pada Minggu pagi.

items.prompt: Coral reef report: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Coral reefs look like rocks, but they are built by tiny animals called polyps. Reefs give food and shelter to many fish. Warmer sea water can turn corals white and weak.

visual.text: Coral reefs are built by animals.

choices.say: Coral reefs are built by animals.

visual.text: Warmer sea water can damage corals.

choices.say: Warmer sea water can damage corals.

visual.text: Corals are a type of rock.

choices.say: Corals are a type of rock.

items.reteach: Terumbu karang dibuat hewan kecil (polip); air yang lebih hangat membuatnya pucat dan lemah.

items.prompt: Rawon text: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Rawon is a black beef soup from East Java. Its dark colour comes from keluak nuts. It is usually served with rice, bean sprouts, and salted egg.

visual.text: People often eat rawon with rice.

choices.say: People often eat rawon with rice.

visual.text: Rawon is red because of chilli.

choices.say: Rawon is red because of chilli.

items.reteach: Rawon = sup daging sapi hitam dari Jawa Timur; warnanya dari kluwak.

items.prompt: Honeybee report: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: A honeybee colony has one queen, many female workers, and some male drones. The workers collect nectar and make honey. The queen lays the eggs.

visual.text: There is only one queen in a colony.

choices.say: There is only one queen in a colony.

items.reteach: Satu ratu bertelur; lebah pekerja (betina) membuat madu; drone adalah lebah jantan.

items.prompt: Kawah Ijen text: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Kawah Ijen in Banyuwangi has a turquoise acid lake. At night, burning sulphur gas creates a rare blue flame. Miners carry heavy baskets of sulphur down the mountain.

visual.text: A blue flame can be seen at night.

choices.say: A blue flame can be seen at night.

visual.text: Miners carry sulphur down the mountain.

choices.say: Miners carry sulphur down the mountain.

visual.text: The lake is good for swimming.

choices.say: The lake is good for swimming.

visual.text: The blue fire appears at noon.

choices.say: The blue fire appears at noon.

items.reteach: Teks menyebut danau asam, api biru di malam hari, dan penambang memikul belerang.

items.prompt: Rafflesia report: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Rafflesia arnoldii has the largest single flower in the world. It has no leaves or stems and lives on a host vine. It smells like rotting meat to attract flies.

visual.text: It has a long green stem.

choices.say: It has a long green stem.

items.reteach: Rafflesia tidak berdaun dan bertangkai, hidup pada tumbuhan inang, dan berbau busuk.

items.prompt: School description: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Our school stands on a hill in Batu. From the classrooms we can see apple orchards. The building is old, but the library has just been renovated.

visual.text: Apple orchards can be seen from the classrooms.

choices.say: Apple orchards can be seen from the classrooms.

visual.text: The school building is brand new.

choices.say: The school building is brand new.

visual.text: The school is near the beach.

choices.say: The school is near the beach.

visual.text: The library is old and damaged.

choices.say: The library is old and damaged.

items.reteach: Bangunannya tua, tetapi perpustakaan baru saja direnovasi.

items.prompt: Javan rhino report: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: The Javan rhino has one horn and thick, folded skin. Fewer than 80 live today, all in Ujung Kulon National Park. It is one of the rarest large mammals on Earth.

visual.text: It lives in a national park.

choices.say: It lives in a national park.

visual.text: Thousands of them live in Java.

choices.say: Thousands of them live in Java.

visual.text: It lives in many parks across Asia.

choices.say: It lives in many parks across Asia.

items.reteach: Badak Jawa bercula satu, jumlahnya kurang dari 80, semuanya di Ujung Kulon.

items.prompt: Reog text: Ketuk semua pernyataan yang sesuai teks.

stimulus.text: Reog Ponorogo is a traditional dance from East Java. The main dancer wears a huge tiger-head mask decorated with peacock feathers. The mask can weigh about 50 kilograms.

visual.text: The mask is light and made of paper.

choices.say: The mask is light and made of paper.

visual.text: Reog is a song from Bali.

choices.say: Reog is a song from Bali.

visual.text: The main dancer wears no mask.

choices.say: The main dancer wears no mask.

items.reteach: Topeng kepala harimau berhias bulu merak beratnya sekitar 50 kg.
